skills.name: delivery-learning
skills.changes: bounded lifecycle evidence into the smallest evidence-backed organizational-learning artifact
skills.trigger: a delivery produces a decision pattern reusable lesson control opportunity outcome question or measurement need
minimum: Feature Delivery Case or learning target
outputs: specialist selection and versioned learning artifact

skills.name: delivery-judgment-playbook
skills.changes: repeated case decisions and outcomes into a scoped judgment playbook with criteria mandatory steps exceptions and review triggers
skills.trigger: multiple delivery cases show a recurring judgment or non-skippable step under named conditions

skills.name: reusable-delivery-pattern
skills.changes: multiple delivery cases into a reusable pattern with conditions checklist failure signals and transfer boundaries
skills.trigger: several cases share a solution shape checklist failure signal or coordination pattern

skills.name: delivery-immune-conversion
skills.changes: validated delivery lessons defects incidents and expired assumptions into bounded control-change proposals
skills.trigger: a verified delivery failure or near miss exposes a test rule check knowledge monitoring or lifecycle gap
outputs: control proposal and evidence-based closure plan

skills.name: feature-outcome-review
skills.changes: feature goals assumptions releases metrics and feedback into an evidence-backed outcome comparison and product recommendation
skills.trigger: a released and enabled feature has enough exposure for an outcome decision
outputs: outcome review recommendation and learning candidates

skills.name: measurement-plan-pack
skills.changes: feature goals workflows assumptions and risks into success criteria telemetry guardrails windows and decision rules
skills.trigger: a feature needs success criteria instrumentation observation windows guardrails or precommitted decision rules
outputs: measurement plan and instrumentation gap list
